Ravi: Quick report — onboarding sampleapp duplicates side-effects when a long /generate hits 429 during token rotation. Seen in Node + Go.

Keiko: Repro? Logs show Retry-After: 0.6 but SDK rounded down -> immediate retry. No Idempotency-Key in quickstart.

Ravi: exact log: 
```
[1765439999] resp 429 Retry-After: 0.6
[1765439999] client retry delay=0ms attempt=1
[1765440005] webhook fired (side-effect)
[1765440005] webhook fired (duplicate)
```

Marta: Two fixes: 1) SDKs must parse Retry-After as float and clamp to min 100ms + apply jitter. 2) Quickstart should auto-add X-Redwood-Idempotency-Key per logical op (UUID) for HTTP flows. For streaming, add opt-in X-Redwood-Replay-Guard so server can make replay-safe decisions.

Marta: Minimal full-jitter snippet (JS):
```js
function backoffMs(attempt, base=200){
  const cap = 20000;
  const raw = Math.min(cap, base * 2**attempt);
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * raw);
}
// if Retry-After present: delay = Math.max(Math.round(parsedRetryAfter*1000), backoffMs(attempt))
```

Keiko: I'll patch Node SDK: parse fractional Retry-After, clamp, generate idempotency header for request builders, and add unit tests simulating token-rotate. Marta can take Go/Python parity.

DevX Bot: Filed RD-9172: "SDK parity: fractional Retry-After + idempotency + replay-guard". Draft docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/sdk/retries#fractional-retry.

Ravi: Thanks. I'll update sampleapp README with explicit idempotency + backoff example and run staging smoke. Will report results here.
